title_en: Artificial Intelligence (12/20): AI on the Farm
note_en: 再 + adjective, followed by 也 or 还, means "no matter how...": 技术再先进，最后还是要靠人去地里走一走 "however advanced the technology gets, in the end someone still has to walk the fields," and 系统再聪明，也离不开……网络信号 "no matter how smart the system is, it can't do without a signal." English needs "however" or "no matter how" up front, but Chinese gets the same concession from 再 in the first clause; the text also uses the more explicit 无论技术多先进 for the same idea.
